data.title: Numbers — Starter · Lesson 2
data.subject: numbers
data.lyrics:
¡Dale!

[Intro]
(It's party time, yeah!)
It's my birthday, let's celebrate.

[Hook]
Uno… One  
Ocho… Eight  
Forty… Cuarenta  
Vamos, it's never too late.  
Fifty… Cincuenta  
Vamos a bailar.  
One hundred… Cien  
Let's party all day.  

[Verse]
The cake's on the table, candles lit bright,  
Primer… First wish, make a wish tonight.  
El doble… The double of fun, you know it's right.  
La mitad… Half of the cake, let's take a bite.  
Segundos… Seconds, we ain't done yet,  
Terceros… Thirds, let's make a bet.  
Mil… One thousand smiles, that's the goal,  
In this house, we celebrate with soul.  

[Hook]  
Uno… One  
Ocho… Eight  
Forty… Cuarenta  
Vamos, it's never too late.  
Fifty… Cincuenta  
Vamos a bailar.  
One hundred… Cien  
Let's party all day.  

[Verse]  
The music's pumping, the DJ's on fire,  
Vamos… Let's go, higher and higher.  
A la mitad… To the halfway point of the night, we're still in the fight.  
El doble… The double of energy, feeling so light.
